note: List of professions for the Professions hub page. Each profession with a research file (research/professions/<file>) gets its own pages; the rest are listed as not written yet. Camp features are the Forever blueprints found on the Wowhead tooltip API (item IDs 273085-273141), with the skill each needs.

groups.title: Gathering professions
groups.blurb: Gathering professions collect raw materials from the world. A character can learn two primary professions, gathering or production.

professions.name: Mining
professions.summary: Ore, stone and gems from mineral veins; smelting ore into bars.

professions.name: Herbalism
professions.summary: Herbs from plants in the world. Forever adds seeds and new level 60 herbs.

professions.name: Skinning
professions.summary: Leather, hides and scales from the corpses of beasts.

groups.title: Production professions
groups.blurb: Production professions turn materials into gear, consumables and tools.

professions.name: Blacksmithing
professions.summary: Mail and plate armor, weapons, and sharpening stones.

professions.name: Enchanting
professions.summary: Permanent enchants on gear, from materials got by disenchanting.

professions.name: Engineering
professions.summary: Gadgets, explosives, scopes, ammunition and goggles.

professions.name: Leatherworking
professions.summary: Leather and mail armor and armor kits.

groups.title: Secondary professions
groups.blurb: Every character can learn all secondary professions alongside their two primary ones.

professions.name: Cooking
professions.summary: Food that restores health and mana and gives buffs.

professions.name: Fishing
professions.summary: Fish for Cooking, plus treasure and rare catches.
